positions.title: Online Teacher
positions.description: Helped students from the ages 8 to 14 create digital projects using popular software development tools. Supported students through specific curriculums and graded their final project submissions. These courses required teachers to have a base understanding of Java and C# as well as hands on experience with the Unity game engine.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Product: VRFCAT

Worked closely with upper management to develop and launch a new version of a virtual cognitive assessment tool using Unreal Engine 4. I was responsible for implementing the user interface, the core game logic, and the localization of both text and assets. This product was successfully shipped and used in multiple cognitive studies.

positions.title: Audio Production Assistant
positions.description:
Products: Unreal Engine 4, Gears of War Judgement, Fortnite, Unannounced project 

Processed audio files and imported them into the game engine to enhance the user experience. Responsible for hooking up sounds into complex visual scripts using UE4 Blueprints and worked closely with audio directors and engine programmers to create, test, and document new audio features.

positions.title: Lead QA Tester
positions.description:
Products: Fortnite, BulletStorm

Worked directly with the QA director to manage fellow testers and create test plans for multiple projects. Responsible for communicating the daily test focus to team members and providing management with daily status reports.

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description:
Products: Unreal Tournament 3, Gears of War 2,  Gears of War 3,  Shadow Complex

Worked with the Lead QA Tester and team members to find and report product issues. Responsible for exploratory testing, regression testing, and test script execution for products running on multiple platforms.
